summary: RUM Group Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a commercial agreement with an unaffiliated U.S. cloud customer for GPU services at its Maysville, GA site (total order value ~$13.7B over six years) and a binding warrant term sheet to issue up to 50,808,408 Class A shares at $0.01 per share, vesting in tranches tied to purchases. This is a customer equity incentive, not a traditional special situation; no premium or tender. Watch for definitive warrant agreement and vesting milestones.
